Done — `python3 -m pytest -q` passes all 6 tests. Both bugs were in `lrucache/cache.py`:

1. **`get()` didn't refresh recency.** A cache hit returned the value without `move_to_end`, so reads never counted as "use" and a freshly-read key could still be evicted as least-recently-used. Fixed by moving the key to the end of the `OrderedDict` on every non-expired hit (`cache.py:30`).

2. **`put()` evicted on in-place updates.** It evicted whenever the cache was at capacity, even when the key being written already existed, so overwriting a key in a full cache wrongly dropped an unrelated entry. Fixed by evicting only when the key is new (`cache.py:34`).

`SOLUTION.md` at the repo root explains both root causes. No test files were touched and no commits were made.
